event.title: Mockingbird Jam 2026
event.subtitle: A full day of music, community, and fundraising. All proceeds benefit ALS-TDI and local families affected by ALS.

hero.headline: Music, community + a day supporting ALS families.
hero.subhead: Join us for a full day of movement, live music, food, activities, basket raffles, and community fundraising in support of ALS-TDI and local families affected by ALS.

event.post_event_message: Mockingbird Jam 2026 has wrapped. Thank you for showing up for the music, the community, and the ALS mission.

als_mission.title: Benefiting ALS-TDI and local families affected by ALS
als_mission.body: All proceeds benefit ALS-TDI and local families affected by ALS. Every sponsorship, raffle ticket, donation, and act of support helps extend that impact.

_note: Auction items have been archived and are not rendered on the public Jam page. For historical reference, see git history if needed.
